note: From 1 May 2026 the Immigration (Transition) Act is the Caymanian Protection Act and its fees are in the Caymanian Protection (Fees) Regulations, 2026, which carry a temporary work permit category for entertainers (item 18). The grant fee follows the occupation's annual fee band; the schedule's nearest occupation for an actor is 'Artist/Musician (person in fine arts/performing arts)', CI$550 a year, giving CI$200 for up to 90 days on Grand Cayman. For 91 to 180 days the fee is half the annual fee.
